en.description: Improved shallow water tiles you own provide +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, increasing to +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production when you reach the Industrial Era.

zh.name: 塔那那利佛宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的文明每获得1位伟人，[ICON_Culture] 文化值便+2%（上限为+30%）。

zh.name: 阿尔马宗主国加成
zh.description: 建造者现在能够建造修道院改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]修道院提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+2 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值、+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。此单元格上的友方宗教单位生命值恢复+15（前提是其当前回合未发动攻击）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每2个相邻的区域使其+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值，“归正会”市政后提升至每1个相邻的区域使其+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。“殖民主义”市政后额外+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]无法建在另一座修道院旁。

en.description: Your Builders can now make Monastery improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_FAITH] Faith and +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. +15 HP healing for friendly religious unit on this tile that has not attacked this turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for every 2 adjacent districts, increasing to +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each adjacent district at Reformed Church. Additional +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing with the Colonialism civic. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism equal to [ICON_FAITH] Faith after researching Flight.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cannot be built next to another Monastery.

zh.name: 格拉纳达宗主国加成
zh.description: 建造者现在能够建造阿卡萨城堡改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]阿卡萨城堡提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力、+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。每相邻一个军营额外+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。提供等于单元格魅力50%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。占领单位 [ICON_Strength] 防御力+4，并自动获得2回合防御工事。研究“飞行”科技后可提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。无法建在另一座阿卡萨城堡旁。

en.description: Your Builders can now make Alcázar improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Alcázars provide +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture per adjacent Encampment. Provides [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 50% of the tile's Appeal. Occupying unit receives +1 Sight and +4 [ICON_STRENGTH] Defense Strength, and automatically gains 2 turns of fortification. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be built next to another Alcázar.

zh.name: 马斯喀特宗主国加成
zh.description: 拥有商业中心区域的城市 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度+1。

zh.name: 米特拉宗主国加成
zh.description: 拥有学院区域的城市增长率将提升15%。

zh.name: 纺织会馆
zh.description: 波兰特色建筑。从此城开始的国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力；国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+4 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

en.name: Sukiennice
en.description: A building unique to Poland. International [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes from this city gain +2 [ICON_Production] Production; domestic [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes gain +4 [ICON_Gold] Gold.

zh.name: 翼骑兵
zh.description: 文艺复兴时期波兰特色单位。如果输出的伤害点数高于敌方，则会将防守的敌方单位弹至后方的单元格中。如防守单位无法后退，则将受到更高的伤害。

en.name: Winged Hussar
en.description: Polish unique Renaissance era unit. Pushes defending enemy units back from their hex in any battle where they score more damage. Defenders that cannot retreat suffer additional damage.

zh.name: 立陶宛联邦
zh.description: 如果相邻城市在波兰文化炸弹的攻击下失去单元格，则波兰创立的宗教将成为此城的主流宗教。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]圣地将从相邻区域获得标准信仰值相邻加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_GreatWork_Relic] 遗物提供的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值+2、[ICON_Culture] 文化值+2、[ICON_Gold] 金币+4。创始和完成宗教时各获得一个遗物。

en.name: Lithuanian Union
en.description: [ICON_DISTRICT_HOLYSITE]Holy Sites gain standard Faith adjacency from adjacent [ICON_DISTRICT] Districts.[NEWLINE]All [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relics generate an additional +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith, +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +4 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. Receive a [ICON_GreatWork_Relic] Relic when founding and when completing a Religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Religion founded by Poland becomes the majority in an adjacent city that loses a tile to a Polish Culture Bomb.

zh.name: 贵族民主制
zh.description: 在友好领土内建成军营或堡垒后对相邻单元格施放文化炸弹。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当前 [ICON_Government] 政体的一个军事政策槽位将转换为一个通配符槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.name: Golden Liberty
en.description: One Military policy slot in the current [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government is converted to a Wildcard policy slot.[NEWLINE]Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing an [ICON_DISTRICT_ENCAMPMENT] Encampment or Fort inside friendly territory.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 塔赛提
zh.description: 生产陆地及海军远程单位时+30% [ICON_Production] 生产力。所有陆地及海军远程单位战斗经验值+50%。战略资源矿产提供+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。加成和奢侈品资源矿产提供+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T5矿山资源。

en.name: Ta-Seti
en.description: +30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Ranged and Naval Ranged units. All Ranged and Naval Ranged units gain +50% combat experience. Mines over strategic resources provide +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION]. Mines over bonus and luxury resources provide +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T2 Plains, T5 Minable Resources.

zh.name: 麦罗埃的甘达刻
zh.description: 建造 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域时+20% [ICON_Production] 生产力。如果城市中拥有努比亚金字塔，加成提升至+40% [ICON_Production] 生产力。所有 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域从努比亚金字塔获得标准相邻加成。

en.name: Kandake of Meroë
en.description: +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts, increasing to +40% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if there is a Nubian Pyramid in the city.

zh.name: 希腊文化融合
zh.description: 征服城市后将获得提升：所有城市获得10 [ICON_TURN] 回合的+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，并且征服城市中每个军营或学院都会启动 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡、每个圣地和剧院广场都带来 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.description: Receive boosts upon city conquest: +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in all cities for 10 [ICON_TURN] turns, as well as a [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka for each Encampment or Campus in the conquered city and an [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration for each Holy Site or Theater Square.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 皇家学堂
zh.description: 马其顿特色建筑。该城中训练的陆地近战、远程单位和伙友骑兵+25%战斗经验值。非平民单位在此城中创建时，获得等同于单位 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力花费20%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]无法建造在已拥有马厩的军营区域中。

en.description: A building unique to Macedon. +25% combat experience for all melee, ranged land units, and Hetairoi trained in this city. Gain [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 20% of the unit's [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost when a non-civilian unit is trained in this city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Stable.

zh.name: 马其顿特色单位：持盾护卫
直到世界尽头
zh.description: 战斗胜利获得被击败单位20% [ICON_Strength] 战斗力的 [ICON_Science] 科技值（联机速度下）。城市不会产生厌战情绪。[NEWLINE]修建军营内建筑时 +25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。占领拥有世界奇观的城市时，所有的军事单位的体力值将完全恢复。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“骑马”科技之后将获得特色单位 “伙友骑兵”。

en.description: Combat victories provide [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 20% of the [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength of the defeated unit (on Online speed). Cities do not incur war weariness. All military units heal completely when this player captures a city with a world wonder. Gain the Hetairoi unique unit when they research the Horseback Riding technology.

zh.name: 荣耀而短促的一生
zh.description: 喜欢与马其顿之外其他国家交战的文明；鄙视处于和平的文明。

zh.name: 行省总督
zh.description: 获得“政治哲学”市政后，+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线。国内贸易路线+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币，研究“银行业”和“经济”后均额外+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。本国领土中的道路提升一个等级。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity with Political Philosophy. Receive +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for domestic Trade Routes, and an additional +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold with Banking and Economics. Roads built in your territory are one level more advanced than usual.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 波斯庭院
zh.description: “帝国初期”市政解锁建造者建造波斯特色改良“波斯庭院”的能力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房，为周围单元格提供+1魅力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每个相邻圣地、学院、剧院广场、市中心+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。每个相邻商业中心、港口、工业区、市中心+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。“外交部门”市政后+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。“飞行”科技后提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不能在雪地、冻土、雪地丘陵或者冻土丘陵上建造，也不能建造在另一座波斯庭院旁。

en.description: Persian unique builder improvement unlocked with Early Empire. Cannot be built on Snow tiles, Tundra tiles or Floodplains. Cannot be build next to another Pairidaeza.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold, +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with Diplomatic Service.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent City Center, Holy Site, Campus, and Theater Square.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each adjacent City Center, Commercial Hub, Harbor, and Industrial Zone.[NEWLINE]+1 Appeal to adjacent tiles.[NEWLINE]Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight.

zh.name: 长生军
zh.description: 波斯特色近战单位，替代剑客。此近战单位可进行远程攻击，[ICON_Range] 范围为2。防御力强。

zh.name: 巴比伦的陨落
zh.description: 所有的单位进攻时+3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。拥有驻扎单位的被占领城市每回合忠诚度+5。宣布突袭战争的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满和好战性与正式战争相同。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]国内贸易路线+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值，解锁“中世纪集市”和“城市化”后均额外+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

en.description: All units get +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking. +5 Loyalty per turn in occupied cities with a garrisoned unit. Declaring a Surprise War counts as a Formal War for the purposes of [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances and warmongering.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for domestic Trade Routes, and an additional +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with Medieval Faires and Urbanization.

zh.name: 机会主义者
zh.description: 喜欢宣布突袭战争的领袖。讨厌不宣布突袭战争的领袖。

zh.name: 南方大陆
zh.description: 所有海岸城市获得+3 [ICON_Housing] 住房。牧场可触发文化炸弹，“帝国初期”市政后额外+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。若单元格魅力为“迷人的”，处于单元格中的学院、商业中心、圣地和剧院广场获得额外+1相邻加成；若单元格魅力为“惊艳的”，则上述的额外产出为+3。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1海岸、T4牧场资源、-T2泛滥平原、-T4雨林。特殊：在海岸时可能没有淡水。

en.name: Land Down Under
en.description: +3 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing in coastal cities. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production on Pastures at Political Philosophy. Pastures trigger a Culture Bomb.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]City Centers gain +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity if they are Charming, doubled if Breathtaking.[NEWLINE]Campuses, Theater Squares, Commercial Hubs, and Holy Sites receive +1 Adjacency in tiles with Charming Appeal, +3 in Breathtaking.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias:T1 Coast, T4 Horse, Cattle, Sheep, -T2 Floodplains, -T4 Rainforest. Special "I am Salty", may spawn coastal without freshwater.

zh.name: 文明的大本营
zh.description: 若其在过去10 [ICON_TURN] 回合内曾解放城市，则+20% [ICON_Production] 生产力。

en.name: Citadel of Civilization
en.description: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for 10 [ICON_TURN] turns after liberating a city.

zh.name: 林地克里人
zh.description: 解锁“货币”科技和“外交部门”市政后分别+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。解锁“对外贸易”市政后在 [ICON_Capital] 首都获得 1 个免费的商人。[NEWLINE]商人首次进入克里城市3个单元格内的无主单元格后，这些单元格将划入克里领土中。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4牧场资源、T4鹿。

en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity with the Pottery technology.[NEWLINE]Unclaimed tiles within 3 tiles of a Cree city come under Cree control when a Trader first moves into them.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Deer, Cattle, Horses, Sheep.

zh.name: 大河地带
zh.description: 与河流相邻时，学院、剧院广场和工业区将获得大量加成。建成港口后可对相邻单元格施放文化炸弹。建造堤坝区域和拦洪坝建筑时 [ICON_Production] 生产力+50%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T2河流、T3海岸。

en.description: Major adjacency bonus for Campuses, Theater Squares, and Industrial Zones if next to a river.[NEWLINE]Culture Bomb adjacent tiles when completing a Harbor.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_Production] Production toward the Dam district and Flood Barrier building.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T2 Rivers, T3 Coast.

zh.name: 驿站
zh.description: 只要拥有比敌方更高的 [ICON_VisLimited] 外交能见度，所有蒙古单位基础 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力加成则翻1倍。创建 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线后，目的地城市中将立即出现1座 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4马。

en.description: All Mongolian units double the usual [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Bonus for having a higher level of [ICON_VisLimited] Diplomatic Visibility than their opponent. Starting a [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route immediately creates a [ICON_TRADINGPOST] Trading Post in the destination city.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Horses.

zh.name: 苏格兰启蒙运动
zh.description: 快乐的城市额外 +5% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；若拥有学院，则 +1 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家点数；若拥有工业区，则 +1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师点数。[NEWLINE]欣喜若狂的城市获得双倍上述加成；极乐的城市获得三倍上述加成。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.description: Happy cities receive an additional +5% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Happy cities generate +1 [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist point per Campus and +1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer point per Industrial Zone. Ecstatic cities double all these amounts.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 三国鼎立
zh.description: 每与一座书院区域相邻，矿山则+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。每与一座书院区域相邻，农场则+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4草原丘陵与平原丘陵。

en.description: Mines receive +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for every adjacent Seowon district. Farms receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every adjacent Seowon district.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Grassland and Plains Hills

zh.name: 团结就是力量
zh.description: 在 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代初期设置着力点时，除原有加成外还将获得提高时代得分的 [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] 普通时代加成。建造防御性建筑时+100% [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4采石场资源。

en.description: When making Dedications at the beginning of a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age, receive the [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age bonus towards improving Era Score in addition to the other bonus.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards walls.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Quarry Resources.

zh.name: 托奇
zh.description: [ICON_Governor] 总督就职城市提供的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值+5%、[ICON_Production] 生产力+5%，此城市中生产的所有单位的战斗经验值+10%。在非马普切建立的城市中，这些数值将乘以三倍。[ICON_Governor] 总督就职城市9单元格范围内的所有城市每回合对本方文明的忠诚度+4。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4草原山脉与平原山脉、-T3泛滥平原。

en.description: Cities with an Established [ICON_Governor] Governor provide +5% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +5% [ICON_Production] Production, and +10% experience in combat towards all units trained in this city. These numbers are tripled in cities not founded by the Mapuche. All cities within 9 tiles of a city with your  [ICON_Governor] Governor gain +4 Loyalty per turn towards your civilization.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Grassland and Plains Mountain, -T3 Floodplains.

zh.name: 部落礼赞
zh.description: 拥有驻军单位的城市每回合忠诚度+3；如驻扎有 [ICON_Corps] 军团或 [ICON_Army] 军队，则+5。如已解锁相关市政，用普通单位占领城市则可将其升级为 [ICON_Corps] 军团/舰队，用 [ICON_Corps] 军团/舰队占领城市则可将其升级为 [ICON_Army] 军队/无敌舰队。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.description: Cities with a garrisoned unit get +3 Loyalty per turn, or +5 if it is a [ICON_CORPS] Corps or [ICON_ARMY] Army. Conquering a city with a unit will upgrade it into a [ICON_CORPS] Corps/Fleet or [ICON_ARMY] Army/Armada if that unit was already a Corp/Fleet, if the proper Civics are unlocked.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 伊布托
zh.description: 可更早组建 [ICON_Corps] 军团（需雇佣兵市政）和 [ICON_Army] 军队（需民族主义市政）。解锁“动员”市政后 [ICON_Corps] 军团和 [ICON_Army] 军队的基础战斗力+2 [ICON_Strength]。

en.description: May form [ICON_CORPS] Corps at the Mercenaries Civic and [ICON_ARMY] Armies at the Nationalism Civic. Corps and Armies both gain +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] base Combat Strength at the Mobilization Civic.

zh.name: 政事论
zh.description: 城市中每个圣地建筑为新训练的军事单位+1 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。拥有神社的城市训练的军事单位+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，拥有寺庙的城市训练的军事单位+1视野。

en.description: Shrines grant +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and Temples grant +1 Sight for all newly trained military units in the city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Units receive +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for each Holy Site building in the city when produced.

zh.name: 班诺克本
zh.description: 侦察单位获得+50%经验值。

en.description: Recon units receive +50% combat experience.

zh.name: 花郎
zh.description: 拥有总督的城市+1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，每次升级（包括首次升级）都将提供+30%书院建筑产出。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“封建主义”市政后，奖励1个 [Icon_Governor] 总督头衔，但由您建立且无 [ICON_Governor] 总督就职的城市-10%所有产出。

en.description: +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity for cities with a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor.[NEWLINE]+30% yield to Seowon buildings for each [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor promotion in the city.[NEWLINE]When you unlock Feudalism, cities you founded without a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor receive -10% to all yields. +1 [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor Title at Feudalism.

zh.name: 世界、王国和信仰的荣光
zh.description: 战斗胜利后，获得等同于被击杀单位战斗力50%的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值（联机速度下）。您向每个信奉您主流宗教的城邦派遣的每一个 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者会被视为2个 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者（需要主流宗教）。来自每位城邦 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值+1。

en.description: Killing a unit provides [ICON_FAITH] Faith equal to 50% of the defeated unit's base [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength (on Online speed). Each [ICON_ENVOY] Envoy you send to a City-state of your majority Religion counts as two [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys (must have a majority Religion). Earn +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith per Envoy in a City-state.

zh.name: 有利条件
zh.description: 所有同盟类型均可形成共享视野。[NEWLINE]你的输出 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，目的地城市每拥有一座营地或牧场，便为你提供+1 [ICON_Food] 食物。[NEWLINE]通往你城市的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线，目的地城市每拥有一座营地或牧场，便为你提供+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

en.description: All Alliance types provide Shared Visibility.[NEWLINE]Your outgoing [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes grant +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food to Poundmaker per Camp or Pasture at the destination. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes sent to your cities grant +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold to Poundmaker per Camp or Pasture at the destination.

zh.name: 橙色电台
zh.description: 通向本方城市的本方 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线每回合可为起源城市+2忠诚度。通往外国城市的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值；起源于外国城市的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线为你提供+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值，为起源城市+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。荷兰海军单位位于圩田单元格时获得+3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]学院每回合提供+1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] 海军统帅点数。

en.description: Your [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to your own cities provide +2 Loyalty per turn for the origin city. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to foreign cities or from foreign cities provide +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture to you and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for the sender. +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for all naval units when defending on a Polder improvement. Dutch campuses provide +1 [ICON_GREATADMIRAL] Great Admiral point.

zh.name: 迅捷之鹰
zh.description: 与处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代的文明或者自由城市作战时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。在敌方城市境内击杀单位时候减少该城市15点忠诚度，若该文明处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代则翻倍。

en.description: +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when fighting Free Cities or civilizations that are in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age. Defeating an enemy unit within the borders of an enemy city causes that city to lose 15 Loyalty, doubled if that civilization is in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age.

zh.name: 蒙古部落
zh.description: 轻重骑兵类单位 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力+3，击败敌方骑兵类单位后有几率将其俘获。

zh.name: 威尼斯宗主国加成
zh.description: 您通往海外城市的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线可从目的地的每个奢侈品资源+2 [ICON_Gold] 金币。

en.description: Your international [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes earn +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Luxury resource at the destination.

zh.name: 安善宗主国加成
zh.description: 每本 [ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] 著作巨作+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。每件 [ICON_GreatWork_RELIC] 遗物和 [ICON_GreatWork_Artifact] 文物+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

zh.name: 迦太基宗主国加成
zh.description: 城市中建成的每个军营区域建筑可使陆地战斗单位的购买 [ICON_GOLD] 金币-20%。

en.name: Carthage Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your Encampment districts provide +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity each.

zh.name: 耶路撒冷宗主国加成
zh.description: 您拥有圣地的城市将释放压力，效果与圣城相同（对10个单元格范围内的所有城市施加4倍宗教压力）。拥有圣地的城市+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

en.name: Jerusalem Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your cities with Holy Sites exert pressure as if they were Holy Cities (4x Religion pressure on all cities within 12 tiles). +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Holy Site.

zh.name: 普雷斯拉夫宗主国加成
zh.description: 所有城市每回合的忠诚度+40。

en.name: Preslav Suzerain Bonus
en.description: You receive +40 Loyalty per turn in all cities.

zh.name: 斯德哥尔摩宗主国加成
zh.description: 您拥有建筑的区域使相应类型的 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数+1（拥有建筑的剧院广场区域提供 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、[ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家和 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数）。

en.name: Stockholm Suzerain Bonus
en.description: Your districts provide +1 [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person point of their type ([ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, and [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician for Theater Square districts).

zh.name: 维尔纽斯宗主国加成
zh.description: 当您最高拥有1/2/3级同盟时，所有剧院广场区域获得+50%/+100%/+150%相邻加成。

en.name: Vilnius Suzerain Bonus
en.description: All your Theater Square districts receive +50%/+100%/+150% adjacency bonus if you have at least one active Alliance of Level 1/2/3.

zh.name: 世界工厂
zh.description: 每回合从矿山收集的 [ICON_RESOURCE_IRON] 铁与 [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] 煤额外增加2点。港口建筑使战略资源储备+10（标准速度下）。生产军事工程师时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。军事工程师+2 [ICON_Charges] 建造次数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1海岸、T5铁、T5煤。

en.description: [ICON_RESOURCE_IRON] Iron and [ICON_RESOURCE_COAL] Coal Mines accumulate 2 more resources per turn. Harbor buildings increase Strategic Resource Stockpiles by +10 (on Standard speed). +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Military Engineers. Military Engineers receive +2 [ICON_CHARGES] charges.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast, T5 Iron and Coal.

zh.name: 阿卡德宗主国加成
zh.description: 近战与抗骑兵单位的攻击可对城墙造成全额伤害。

zh.name: 博洛尼亚宗主国加成
zh.description: 拥有建筑的区域使相应类型的 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人点数+1（拥有建筑的剧院广场区域提供 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、[ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家和 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数）。

zh.name: 卡霍基亚宗主国加成
zh.description: 建造者可以建造卡霍基亚土墩改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。城市建造首座卡霍基亚土墩改良设施可提供+1点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。发现“自然历史”后，城市建造的第二座卡霍基亚土墩改良设施可提供+1点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。解锁“封建主义”后，每2个相邻区域+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；或研究“零件规格化”后，每个相邻区域+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。提供+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房；发现“文化遗产”后，可额外获得1点 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。无法建造在另一个卡霍基亚土墩旁。

zh.name: 加的夫宗主国加成
zh.description: 每个港口内建筑+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力、+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、并向城市提供2点 [ICON_Power] 电力。

en.description: +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold, and +2 [ICON_POWER] Power for every Harbor building.

zh.name: 非斯宗主国加成
zh.description: 利用宗教单位使得城市首次皈依你的宗教时，该城市的每1 [ICON_Citizen] 人口为你提供10 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

en.description: When you use a religious unit to convert a city for the first time earn 10 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science per [ICON_CITIZEN] Population of that city (standard speed).

zh.name: 墨西哥城宗主国加成
zh.description: 来自工业区、水上乐园和娱乐设施的区域效果范围增加3个单元格。拥有水渠的城市+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。

en.description: Regional effects from your Industrial Zone, Water Park, and Entertainment Complex districts reach 3 tiles farther. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity from Aqueducts.

zh.name: 纳斯卡宗主国加成
zh.description: 建造者可以建造纳斯卡巨画改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]纳斯卡巨画向相邻单元格提供+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值；拥有资源的相邻单元格+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。发现“行政部门”后，相邻的沙漠、沙漠丘陵单元格+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。研究“大量生产”后，相邻的平原单元格+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；同时+1魅力。仅能建在沙漠平原中。此单元格无法派遣人口工作。

zh.name: 纳札加姆宗主国加成
zh.description: 城市中每拥有1个“军营”内建筑，购买陆地战斗或者支援单位所需要的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币或者 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值便减少10%。

en.description: Land combat or Support units are 10% cheaper to purchase with [ICON_GOLD] Gold or [ICON_FAITH] Faith for each Encampment district building in that city.

zh.name: 拉帕努伊宗主国加成
zh.description: 建造者可以建造摩艾石像改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]摩艾石像提供+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。每2个相邻的摩艾石像+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。在火山土单元格之上或与其相邻时，+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。与海岸或湖泊单元格相邻时，+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。随着市政与科技树的发展，可获得额外的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值与 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。可建在平原、平原丘陵、草原、草原丘陵或火山土之上。

en.description: Your Builders can now make Moai improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every 2 adjacent Moai, increasing to each adjacent Moai at Medieval Faires. +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if on or adjacent to a Volcanic Soil tile. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture if adjacent to a Coast or Lake tile. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Can be built on Plains, Plains Hills, Grassland, Grassland Hills, or Volcanic Soil.

zh.name: 和平四颜
zh.description: 无法对城邦宣战或发动突袭战争。无法对加拿大发动突袭战争。每回合每获得100点 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩，即可每回合获得1点 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。成功完成紧急状况或积分竞赛后+100% [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1冻土。特殊：更深的冻土。

en.description: Cannot declare war on City-States or surprise wars. Surprise wars cannot be declared on Canada.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For every 100 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per turn earn 1 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor per turn. Receive +100% [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor from successfully completing an Emergency or Scored Competition.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Tundra.

zh.name: 多瑙河之珠
zh.description: 在市中心河对岸修建区域与建筑时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4河流、T5地热裂缝、T-5海洋。

en.description: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to [ICON_DISTRICT] Districts and Buildings constructed directly across a river from a City Center.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T4 Rivers, T5 Geothermal Fissures.

zh.name: 米塔制度
zh.description: 公民可改良山脉单元格。山脉单元格提供+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，通过科技或市政进入工业时代后额外+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]城市不受非 [ICON_Food] 食物产出的负宜居惩罚。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3草原山脉与平原山脉。特殊：允许周边存在大量山脉。

en.description: Citizens can work Mountain tiles. Mountain tiles provide +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, increasing to +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production after you reach the Industrial Era, and +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each adjacent Terrace Farm.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cities do not suffer penalties on non-food yields for being negative amenities.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Grassland and Plains Mountains. Special "Mountain Lover".

zh.name: 杰利之歌
zh.description: [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都或市中心位于沙漠单元格的城市每回合获得 +1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]非自然奇观或地貌的沙漠和沙漠丘陵单元格提供 +2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；未改良提供 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；改良为矿山提供 +2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]可用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买商业中心区域建筑。所有城市 -10% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；但是每通过科技或市政进入一个新时代，所有城市 +1% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力（从古典时期开始，上限至现代 +5%）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1沙漠、T5矿山资源、T-1海洋。

en.description: -15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in all cities.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_FOOD] Food on all featureless Desert tiles other than City Centers.[NEWLINE]Your capital and any cities settled on Desert tiles gain +2 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE]Farms can be constructed in Desert. After Civil Engineering is unlocked, Farms can be built on Desert Hills.[NEWLINE]Mines on desert tiles grant +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Desert, T5 Minable Resources.

zh.name: 玛那
zh.description: “造船术”科技后，水运单位+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。渔船向相邻单元格投放文化炸弹，并在“天文导航”科技后提供+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。无法收获资源；无法获得 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]未改良的树林与雨林：[NEWLINE]在“政治哲学”后提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；[NEWLINE]在“重商主义”后额外提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；[NEWLINE]在“保护地球”后额外+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；[NEWLINE]在“冷战”后额外+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1海岸。

en.description: Embarked units gain +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement with Ship Building. Fishing Boats Culture Bomb adjacent tiles and provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food with Celestial Navigation. Resources cannot be harvested. [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writers cannot be earned.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unimproved Woods and Rainforest tiles gain:[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Early Empire.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Mercantilism.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production with Conservation.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 帕堡
zh.description: 一种特色改良设施

zh.name: 达达尼尔射石炮
zh.description: 生产攻城单位时 [ICON_Production] 生产力+50%。所有攻城单位+3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。征服城市不会造成 [ICON_Citizen] 人口损失。非奥斯曼建立的城市每回合+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度和+4忠诚度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3河流、T5硝石、T-3海洋。

en.description: +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward siege units. All siege units gain +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.[NEWLINE]Conquered cities do not lose [ICON_CITIZEN] population. Cities not founded by the Ottomans gain +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity and +4 Loyalty per turn.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rivers, T5 Niter.

zh.name: 地中海殖民地
zh.description: 游戏开始便激活“写作”科技 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。腓尼基建造的海岸城市若与 [ICON_Capital] 首都在同一大陆，则其忠诚度为100%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1海岸。

en.description: Begin the game with the Writing technology [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka. Coastal cities founded by Phoenicia and located on the same continent as the Phoenician [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital are 100% Loyal. Settlers gain +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and +2 sight range while embarked. Settlers ignore additional [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement costs from embarking and disembarking.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 诺贝尔奖
zh.description: 瑞典招募 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人时可获得20点 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持（标准速度下）。工厂和大学分别提供+1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师点数和+1 [ICON_GreatScientist] 大科学家点数。如果瑞典在游戏中，进入文艺复兴时代之后将增添3项特色世界议会竞赛。[NEWLINE]建造市政广场建筑时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：特殊：靠近冻土。

en.description: Sweden gains 20 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor (on Standard speed) when earning a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person. Having Sweden in the game adds three unique World Congress competitions starting in the Renaissance Era.[NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Libraries, Workshops, Universities, Factories and Government Plaza buildings.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] Great Engineer point from Factories.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_GreatScientist] Great Scientist point from Universities.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATWRITER] Great Writer points from tier 1 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATARTIST] Great Artist points from tier 2 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] Great Muscician points from tier 3 Gov't Plaza building.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: Special "King of the North"

zh.name: 迦太基建国者
zh.description: 每个市政广场建筑+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。在拥有市政广场的城市中建造 [ICON_DISTRICT] 区域时+50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有“造船术”科技后：开拓者上船后，[ICON_Movement] 移动力与视野范围各 +2；开拓者上船和下船无需额外花费 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。

en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity for each Government Plaza building. +50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward [ICON_DISTRICT] districts in the city with the Government Plaza.

zh.name: 爱之法庭
zh.description: 仅埃莉诺（法国）：建造远古时代和古典时期奇观时+20% [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE]仅埃莉诺（英国）：灯塔提供 +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家点数，造船厂提供 +1 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家点数，码头提供 +1 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造剧院广场区域内建筑时+100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。城市中的每个巨作使9格内外国城市每回合-1忠诚度。因忠诚度而脱离其他文明的城市，若对你有最高忠诚度压力，则跳过自由城市阶段直接加入你。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]巨作根据所在城市拥有的区域获得额外产出：（著作和遗物+1，艺术和文物+2，音乐+4）[NEWLINE]拥有学院则获得 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE]拥有剧院广场则获得 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]拥有港口或商业中心则获得 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]拥有圣地则获得 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]拥有工业区或军营则获得 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]拥有社区则获得 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]（巨作无法获得城邦宗主提供的额外产出）

en.description: +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Theater Square Buildings. +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Ancient and Classical wonders (French Eleanor only).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Works receive additional yields based on the districts built in this city (+1 for [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Writings and [ICON_GREATWORK_RELIC] Relics, +2 for [ICON_GREATWORK_LANDSCAPE] Art and [ICON_GREATWORK_ARTIFACT] Artifacts, +4 for [ICON_GREATWORK_MUSIC] Music):[NEWLINE][ICON_SCIENCE] Science for Campus.[NEWLINE][ICON_CULTURE] Culture for Theater Square.[NEWLINE][ICON_GOLD] Gold for Harbor or Commercial Hub.	[NEWLINE][ICON_FAITH] Faith for Holy Site.[NEWLINE][ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for Industrial Zone.[NEWLINE][ICON_FOOD] Food for Neighborhood.[NEWLINE](Can't receive bonus yields on great works from Anshan)[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Great Works in Eleanor's cities each cause -1 Loyalty per turn in foreign cities within 9 tiles. A city that leaves another civilization due to a loss of Loyalty and is currently receiving the most Loyalty per turn from Eleanor's civilization skips the Free City step to join this civilization.

zh.name: 北方的弥涅耳瓦
zh.description: 当所有槽位填满时，拥有至少 3 个 [ICON_GREATWORK_LANDSCAPE] 巨作槽位的建筑和拥有至少 2 个 [ICON_GREATWORK_LANDSCAPE] 巨作槽位的奇观可自动获得 [ICON_THEMEBONUS_ACTIVE] 主题加成。发现“历史记录”后，可以在市政广场建造女王图书馆。[NEWLINE]一级/二级/三级市政广场建筑分别为您的帝国提供2点[ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家、 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数。

zh.name: 库佩的航行
zh.description: “航海术”科技后，允许开拓者上船。宫殿获得+3 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。

en.description: Settlers can embark after researching the Sailing technology. The Palace grants +3 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing.

zh.name: 西部净土
zh.description: 位于冻土的 [ICON_Capital] 首都市中心获得 +1 [ICON_Food] 食物。[NEWLINE]允许在冻土地貌上建造农场。解锁“土木工程”市政后，即可在冻土丘陵上建造农场。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在冻土、冻土丘陵、雪地、雪地丘陵上的改良设施：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]矿山和伐木场额外提供 +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]农场和营地额外提供 +2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]采石场额外提供 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]种植园和牧场额外提供 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]冻土和雪地上的战略资源积累速度 +100%；这些地形上的单元格 [ICON_GOLD] 购买费用降低 50%。

en.description: City Centers in Tundra receive +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Farms can be constructed in Tundra. After Civil Engineering is unlocked, Farms can be built on Tundra Hills. Improvements in Tundra and Snow receive the following bonuses: Mines and Lumber Mills +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production, Farms and Camps +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food. Receive double the normal accumulation rate for Strategic Resources improved in tundra and snow. -50% of the normal cost to purchase Snow and Tundra tiles.

zh.name: 渡鸦之王
zh.description: 征集单位+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。升级征集单位花费的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币和资源减少75%。征集城邦单位时可在该城邦增加1名 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者。研究“城堡”科技后获得特色单位黑军。

en.description: Levied units gain an ability giving them +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement. It cost 75% less [ICON_GOLD] Gold and resources to upgrade Levied units. If you Levy troops from a City-state, receive 1 [ICON_ENVOY] Envoys with that City-state. Gain the Black Army unique unit when the Castles technology is researched.

zh.name: 萨赫勒商人
zh.description: 创立 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教后可以无视前置科技建造曼丁哥市场，并 +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。完成 [ICON_RELIGION] 宗教时再 +1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]曼丁哥市场从圣地获得额外 [ICON_GOLD] 金币标准相邻加成。建造圣地及其中的建筑时+25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity after Banking. Holy Sites grant major adjacency to Sugubas instead of standard adjacency. +15% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward Holy Sites and their buildings.

zh.name: 印加路网
zh.description: 起始城市中的每座山脉单元格为国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_Food] 食物，为国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。解锁“对外贸易”市政后可获得印加路网改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]购买山脉单元格的价格只需要原来的50%。侦察兵拥有一次 [ICON_Charges] 劳动力次数，能建造印加路网。

en.description: Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes gain +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for every Mountain tile in the origin city. International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes gain +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every Mountain tile in the origin city. -50% of the normal [ICON_GOLD] Gold cost to purchase Mountain tiles.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain the Qhapaq Ñan improvement with Foreign Trade. Recon units gain +1 [ICON_CHARGES] build charge to build a Qhapaq Ñan.

zh.name: 大维齐尔
zh.description: 拥有军事与外交能力的专属特色总督“易卜拉辛”。[NEWLINE]发现“行政部门”市政后奖励 1 个 [ICON_Governor] 总督头衔；研究完“火药”科技后获得特色单位“苏丹亲兵”。

zh.name: 古迹与公园
zh.description: “法典”市政后，魅力值为“惊艳”的单元格：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]与自然奇观或山脉相邻时，+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值，研究“天文学”后翻倍；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]与自然奇观或树林相邻时，+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值，解锁“启蒙运动”后翻倍。[NEWLINE]国境内的雨林不会降低相邻单元格的吸引力。拥有“中世纪集市”市政后即可栽种树林。

en.description: After Code of Laws, breathtaking tiles receive:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science when adjacent to either a Natural Wonder or a Mountain, doubled with Astronomy.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when adjacent to either a Natural Wonder or Woods, doubled with Enlightenment.[NEWLINE]Woods can be planted with Medieval Faires.

zh.name: 德瑞克的遗产
zh.description: 完成“造船术”、“探索”、“重商主义”后，均获得 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量+1。起源城市中每有一个专业化区域，[ICON_TradeRoute] 通往任意城邦的贸易路线便+3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]用海军单位掠夺 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的收益+100%。海军袭击者单位+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力、+1视野。[ICON_PROMOTION] 升级海军袭击者单位时不会结束其回合。

en.description: +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity with Shipbuilding technology, Exploration civic and Mercantilism civic. [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes to City-states provide +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every [ICON_DISTRICT] specialty district in the origin city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All Naval Raider units gain +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement and +1 Sight. Naval Raiders can attack and promote in the same turn. +100% [ICON_GOLD] Gold from Plundering [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes with Naval Units.

zh.name: 北欧卫队
zh.description: 每宗主1个城邦，海军单位进攻时+1 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。征集单位的花费-75%，征集单位完成击杀时获得等同于对手 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力50%的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、[ICON_FAITH] 信仰值和 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。征集单位+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造圣地建筑时+25% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。木板教堂+1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] 影响力点数。利用宗教单位使城市首次改变信仰时，该城市每拥有1点 [ICON_Citizen] 人口，则提供10点 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、10点 [ICON_Culture] 文化值（标准速度下）。

en.description: +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength on naval units when attacking per city-state you are suzerain of. 75% Discount on Levying units and levied units receive [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith from kills equal to 50% of the opponent's [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength. +1 Movement to levied units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+25% production to [ICON_DISTRICT_HOLYSITE] Holy Site buildings. Stave Church generates +1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] Influence point. +10 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +10 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture (standard speed) per population when converting a city to your religion for the first time using a religious unit.

zh.name: 蒸汽时代
zh.description: 战略资源提供 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。城市中每有一座工厂或发电厂，便 +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。拥有电力供给时，建筑的额外产出+4。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]灯塔提供 +1 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师点数。工业区和皇家海军船坞为彼此提供额外大量相邻加成。

en.description: +5% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in Cities for each Factory and Power Plant in that city. Buildings that provide additional yields when [ICON_POWER] Powered receive +4 of that yield. Industrial Zones receive standard adjacency from Royal Navy Dockyards. +20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Industrial Zone buildings.[NEWLINE]Lighthouse grants +1 [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer point per turn.

zh.name: 解放黑奴宣言
zh.description: 建造工业区、水渠时 +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]工业区提供 +2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度，+3 每回合忠诚度；[NEWLINE]水渠提供 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房；[NEWLINE]但种植园提供 -2 每回合忠诚度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建造工业区和其建筑后获得1个免费近战单位。免费单位 +5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，生成或维护不需要资源。

en.description: +100% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Industrial Zone and Aqueduct districts. Industrial Zones give +2 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenities and +3 Loyalty per turn. Plantations give -2 Loyalty per turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive a free Melee unit after completing an Industrial Zone and their buildings. The free unit does not require strategic resources when created or to maintain.

zh.name: 王者之师
zh.description: 玩家可以使用平时 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值消耗的9/10 来购买他们的学院建筑。使徒使一环内的陆地军事单位获得+5[ICON_Strength]战斗力。每回合、每单位维护费用减少1 [Icon_Gold] 金币。

en.description: Military units receive +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength if they are within 1 tile of an apostle.  Can purchase encampment and campus buildings with faith at a 10% discount.[NEWLINE]All Units cost 1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold less maintenance per turn.

zh.name: 恩东戈和马坦巴的女王
zh.description: 每回合获得的 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家、[ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家和 [ICON_GreatMusician] 大音乐家点数 +50%。商业中心和剧院广场为彼此提供额外大量相邻加成。考古学家购买花费减少50%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有姆班赞的城市获得下列加成：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]研究“飞行”科技后，每个区域提供 +2 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]所有平民单位在树林和雨林中移动时无 [ICON_Movement] 移动力减益。

en.description: +10% [ICON_GOLD] Gold and 10% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture in cities with a [ICON_DISTRICT_MBANZA] Mbanza (does not stack with multiples). [ICON_DISTRICT_MBANZA] Mbanza provides +2 adjacency to [ICON_DISTRICT_THEATER] Theater Squares and [ICON_DISTRICT_COMMERCIAL_HUB] Commercial Hubs. Archaeologists are 50% cheaper to purchase.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All civilian units ignore the Rainforest and Woods [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement penalty.

zh.name: 三十六计
zh.description: 近战单位获得“蛮族归顺”操作。此操作能将蛮族单位转化为你的单位，但会移除近战单位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]军营获得+1 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家点数，建造军营建筑时+50% [Icon_Production] 生产力，兵营和马厩获得2个 [ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] 著作槽位。[ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] 著作 +1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值，+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]招募 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军或 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家时获得一项随机 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞（如可用）。若相邻长城，长城获得1点 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.description: Melee units receive the Convert Barbarians action, which consumes the melee unit.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Encampment buildings. +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer point from Encampment districts. Barracks buildings provide 2 slots for [ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] Great Works of Writing. Great Works of Writing provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] Food.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When recruiting a Great General or Great Writer receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration.

zh.name: 里甲
zh.description: 至少拥有 2 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口的城市可进行“里甲”项目，专注于以每回合的城市生产力来转换为 [Icon_Food] 食物（60%）、[Icon_Faith] 信仰值（70%）或者 [Icon_GOLD] 金币（150%）。10个人口或以上的大型城市，每一个人口便提供+1 [Icon_Gold] 金币、+0.7 [Icon_Science] 科技值以及+0.5 [Icon_Culture] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每有城市达到13人口时，获得一项随机 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡（如可用）；每有城市达到18人口时，获得一项随机 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞（如可用）。若相邻长城，长城获得1点 [ICON_Food] 食物。

en.description: Cities with 10 or more [ICON_CITIZEN] Population receive +0.7 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, +0.5 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold per turn for each [ICON_CITIZEN] Population in the city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All cities receive unique city projects where that converts 70% of their [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production into [ICON_FOOD] Food or [ICON_FAITH] Faith, or 150% if it is [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When each city reaches 13 [ICON_CITIZEN] population for the first time receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka; at 18 [ICON_CivicBoosted] Population receive a random [ICON_CITIZEN] Inspiration.

zh.name: 罗织经
zh.description: 进攻性间谍的行动效果提升 1 级。进攻性间谍任务成功时，获得目标城市该回合 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值的 100% 和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值、 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值的 50%。解锁“行政部门”市政后获得 1 名免费间谍（和一个额外的间谍容量）。可以使用[ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买间谍。[NEWLINE]位于侦察单位 3 单元格范围的陆地单位 +3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]建成市政广场建筑或外交区建筑时获得一项随机 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞（如可用）。若相邻长城，长城获得1点 [ICON_Science] 科技值

en.description: Receive a free spy (and extra spy capacity) after discovering Civil Service. Can purchase Spies with [ICON_FAITH] Faith. All offensive Spies operate at 1 level higher. Whenever an offensive spy mission is successful, you also gain 100% of the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and [ICON_FAITH] Faith that the targeted city earned that turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Land units within 3 tiles of a Recon unit receive +3 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When completing a Government Plaza building or Diplomatic Quarter building receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration.

zh.name: 阿布辛贝
zh.description: 建筑建成时，获得等同于建筑花费10%的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值（若城市中已拥有奇观则提升至20%）；奇观建成时则获得25%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]城市若建立在河流旁，建造圣地和工业区时+15% [ICON_Production] 生产力。圣地和工业区从河流获得 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力相邻加成。

en.description: Gain [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 10% of the construction cost when finishing Buildings, doubled for cities with a wonder and 25% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when completing Wonders. Holy Sites are granted +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production if built adjacent to a River.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+15% production bonus for Holy Sites and Industrial Zones when the city is settled on a river.

zh.name: 哈庇的降临
zh.description: 通过科技或市政进入古典时期后，所有军事单位不会受到来自河流的 [ICON_Movement] 移动力和 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力减益。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]城市若建立在河流旁，建造学院和军营时+15% [ICON_Production] 生产力。学院和军营从河流获得+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值相邻加成。

en.description: Military units can cross rivers without movement or combat penalty starting in the classical era.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+15% production bonus for Campuses and Encampments when the city is settled on a river. Campus and Encampments receive major [ICON_SCIENCE] Science adjacency from rivers.

zh.name: 索格伦
zh.description: 招募伟人所花费的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币 -30%，马里所建城市的市场获得2个 [ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] 著作槽位。[ICON_GreatWork_WRITING] 著作 +4 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+2 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]曼丁哥市场从剧院广场获得标准 [ICON_GOLD] 金币相邻加成；从市中心、圣地、河流、绿洲和剧院广场获得标准 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值相邻加成。拥有曼丁哥市场和剧院的城市+1 [ICON_GREATWRITER] 大作家点数。

en.description: Patronage of [ICON_GREATPERSON] Great People costs 30% less [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Theater Squares grant standard adjacency to  Sugubas. Cities with a Theater Square and Suguba receive +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer point. Markets gain 2 slots for [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Great Works of Writing in cities founded by Sundiata. [ICON_GREATWORK_WRITING] Great Works of Writing grant +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +4 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.

zh.name: 爱国军
zh.description: 获得“政治哲学”市政后，所有军事单位+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。[ICON_PROMOTION] 升级骑兵、间谍、空军单位时不会结束其回合。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T5种植园资源。

en.description: +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for all military units after researching Political Philosophy. Promoting Cavalry units, Air units and Spies does not end these units' turn.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T5 Plantation Resources.

zh.name: 玛雅布
zh.description: 在淡水和海岸旁定居时不提供额外 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房；但每座农场额外+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房、+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币，每与一座天文台相邻则+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。种植园每与一座天文台相邻则+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值，“教育”科技后提升至+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。每有 1 个奢侈品与市中心相邻，则+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_Capital] 首都+1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。拥有天文台的城市 +1 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3种植园资源、T4香蕉。特殊：距离水域更远。

en.description: Settling adjacent to Fresh Water and Coast does not provide extra [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. The Palace receives +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing. +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity for every Luxury adjacent to the City Center.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Farms provides an additional +1 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing, +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for every adjacent Observatory, and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Plantations provide +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for each adjacent Observatory and an additional +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science with Education.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Plantation Luxuries, T4 Bananas. Special "Hydrophobic".

zh.name: 荣耀之战
zh.description: 游戏每进入一个新时代则获得1名总指挥。无法招募 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军。

en.description: Earn a Comandante General when the game enters a new era. May not recruit [ICON_GreatGeneral] Great Generals.

zh.name: 穆塔尔忠烈之女
zh.description: [ICON_Capital] 首都 6 个单元格范围内的非首都城市所有产出 +5%。[ICON_Capital] 首都 6 单元格范围内的单位 +3 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。游戏开始便激活“灌溉”科技 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。

en.description: Non-capital cities within 6 tiles of the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital gain +5% to all yields. Other non-capital cities receive -10% to all yields.

zh.name: 卡瓜纳宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的建造者现在可以建造改良设施巴特依。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。每与1个加成资源或娱乐设施相邻+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值（拥有“探索”市政后+2 [Icon_Culture] 文化值），每与1个战略资源相邻+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力，每与1个奢侈品资源相邻+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。研究完“飞行”后将产出 [Icon_Tourism] 旅游业绩。无法建造在另一座巴特依旁。

en.description: Your Builders can now make Batey improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every adjacent Bonus Resource and Entertainment Complex, increasing to +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when Exploration is discovered. +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for every adjacent Strategic resource. +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every adjacent Luxury resource. Provides [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism after researching Flight. Cannot be build adjacent to another Batey.

zh.name: 罕萨宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线每经过5个单元格，其提供的 [ICON_Gold] 金币便+1。

zh.name: 拉合尔宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的城市现在可以生产尼杭战士。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]这种单位拥有独特的升级树，可以通过 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买。首次建造出兵营、兵工厂和军事学院时，都会为其提供+15 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。从任何时代的 [ICON_GREATGENERAL] 大将军获得加成。

en.description: Your cities can now train Nihang units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]A unit with a unique Promotion tree. Purchasable with [ICON_FAITH] Faith. +15 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when Barracks, Armory, and Military Academy buildings are first constructed. Receives bonuses from [ICON_GREATGENERAL] Great General from any era.

zh.name: 新加坡宗主国加成
zh.description: 国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

en.description: Your international [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes provide +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.

zh.name: 塔鲁加宗主国加成
zh.description: 所有城市每拥有一种不同的改良战略资源，便+5% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。

zh.name: 梵蒂冈城宗主国加成
zh.description: 当您激活一位 [ICON_GreatPerson] 伟人时，其会将您所创立宗教（或您主流宗教）的400点宗教压力传播到6单元格内的城市。

en.description: When you activate a [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person they spread 400 Religious pressure of your founded (or majority) religion to cities within 6 tiles.

zh.name: 我来，我见，我征服
zh.description: 首次征服一座城市或从蛮族哨站获得[ICON_GOLD] 金币时 +150 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。研究完“金属铸造”之后，两者提供的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币数量变为250，研究完“钢铁”之后，变为350（标准速度下）。当目标为蛮族时，获得+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力且总是获得正常经验值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“法典”市政后，首都获得一个免费的勇士。除首都外，建立新城市时获得一个免费的近战单位。占领并保留至少一个城市时（该城市必须由任意主要文明建立，且被占领时属于主要文明），每种 [ICON_Government] 政体获得一个额外的通配符槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]所有单位获得+50%战斗经验值，通过科技或市政进入中世纪后提升至+100%。

en.description: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]All Units receive +50% Combat Experience, increasing to +100% when entering the medieval era. When targeting Barbarians, receive +5 Combat Strength and always earn normal XP.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive a free melee unit each time you found a non-capital city and in your capital after researching Code of Laws.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Gain an extra Wildcard Policy slot when capturing and retaining at least one city founded by a major civilization and owned by a major civilization at the time of capture (maximum 1 extra wildcard slot). +150 [ICON_GOLD] Gold when you conquer a city for the first time or when you capture a [ICON_BARBARIAN] Barbarian Outpost, increasing to +250 [ICON_GOLD] Gold after researching Metal Casting and +350 [ICON_GOLD] Gold after Steel (on Standard speed).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Cities with a Roman Bath gain +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity.

zh.name: 天授规矩
zh.description: 每有1座圣城皈依拜占庭的宗教（也包括拜占庭的圣城），单位便获得+2 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力或 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力。如城市拥有圣地区域，其提供的 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数+1。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]击杀敌方文明或城邦的单位时，拜占庭的宗教将传播到5单元格内的城市（宗教压力基于被击杀单位的 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力）。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.description: Units receive +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength or [ICON_RELIGION] Religious Strength for each Holy City converted to Byzantium's Religion (including Byzantium's Holy City). +1 [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet point from cities with a [ICON_DISTRICT_HOLYSITE] Holy Site district.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]When defeating a unit, spreads Byzantium's Religion pressure (based on melee [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength of the defeated unit) within 5 tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: None.

zh.name: 哈尔施塔特文化
zh.description: 矿山为所有区域提供少量相邻加成。采石场为所有区域提供标准相邻加成。专业化区域与其他区域相邻时不会获得少量相邻加成；专业化区域也无法建在市中心旁。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3铁、T5采石场资源、T5矿山奢侈品与加成资源。

en.description: Quarries provide a standard adjacency for all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts (doubled for the Oppidum), mines provide a minor adjacency bonus for all [ICON_DISTRICT] districts. Specialty [ICON_DISTRICT] districts do not receive a minor adjacency for being adjacent to another district and these districts cannot be built adjacent to the City Center.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Iron, T4 Quarry Resources, T5 Minable Resources.

zh.name: 厄勃隆尼斯之王
zh.description: 矿山对相邻无主单元格释放文化炸弹。每与 1 个军事单位相邻，近战和抗骑兵单位便 +1 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]解锁“铸铜术”科技后，生产出一个军事单位时，您的文明将获得等同于该单位成本 25% 的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

en.description: Melee and anti-cavalry units receive +1 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for each adjacent unit.

zh.name: 生于紫室
zh.description: 对所信仰宗教与拜占庭相同的城市发起进攻时，轻重骑兵将输出全额伤害。解锁“王权神授”市政后将获得特色单位“甲胄骑兵”。

zh.name: 九龙江三角洲
zh.description: 所有陆地专业化区域只能建造在雨林、沼泽、树林或泛滥平原上。建在这些地貌上的建筑将获得以下收益（泛滥平原除外）：建在树林上提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、建在雨林上提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、建在沼泽上提供+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。拥有“中世纪集市”市政后即可栽种树林。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3树林、T3雨林、T3沼泽。

en.description: All land specialty districts can only be built on Rainforest, Woods, Marsh, or Floodplains. Receive the following yields for every building on these features: +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science in Rainforest, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture in Woods, and +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production in Marsh, and no additional yields on Floodplains.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Woods can be planted with Medieval Faires.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rainforest, Woods, Marsh.

zh.name: 腰牌
zh.description: 任意 [ICON_Government] 政体中额外增加一个经济政策槽位。首次在另一个文明的城市中建立 [ICON_TradingPost] 贸易站时随机获得一项 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡和 [ICON_CivicBoosted] 鼓舞。[NEWLINE]从国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线每经过20个单元格，额外提供+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值和+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。（仅忽必烈中国）若相邻长城，长城获得1点 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。

en.description: One extra Economic policy slot in any [ICON_GOVERNMENT] government.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture per international trade route and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each 25 tiles traveled on all trade routes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive a random [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka and [ICON_CivicBoosted] Inspiration when establishing a [ICON_TRADINGPOST] Trading Post in another Civilization's city for the first time.

zh.name: 驱除吴军
zh.description: 在雨林、沼泽或树林单元格中战斗的单位+2 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。如果单位在回合开始时处于您的领土的这些地貌中，则额外+2 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力、+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。

en.description: +2 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement for all units beginning their turn in Rainforest, Woods, or Marsh tiles within your empire. +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for units fighting in these tiles.

zh.name: 寻欢作乐的凯瑟琳
zh.description: “技艺”市政后，改良资源额外 +1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。与剧院广场相邻的改良资源额外 +1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。与城堡相邻的改良资源额外 +1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。“中世纪集市”市政后，可在拥有剧院广场区域的任意城市中开展“宫廷盛会”项目。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]快乐的城市额外 +5% [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值，若拥有剧院广场，则 +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] 大作家点数；[NEWLINE]欣喜若狂的城市获得双倍上述 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值加成，若拥有剧院广场，则 +1 [ICON_GreatArtist] 大艺术家点数。

en.description: Improved resources receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture after researching Craftsmanship. Chateau adjacent to a luxury resource receive +1 [ICON_AMENITIES] Amenity. Happy cities gain +5% Culture and grant +1 [ICON_GreatWriter] Great Writer, [ICON_GreatArtist] Great Artist, and [ICON_GreatMusician] Great Musician point from Theater Squares, these numbers are doubled if ecstatic. May initiate the Court Festival unique project in any city with a Theater Square district.

zh.name: 幕藩
zh.description: 国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的产出和 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩 -25%；[NEWLINE]国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线的目的地城市中每有一个专业化区域，便提供：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+0.5 [ICON_Culture] 文化值（“人文主义”市政后翻倍）；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+0.5 [ICON_Science] 科技值（“教育”科技后翻倍）[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]+0.5 [Icon_Gold] 金币。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]港口不受到市中心的相邻加成。在日本 [ICON_Capital] 首都 6 单元格内的城市为 100% 忠诚；研究完“飞行”后，每个区域提供 +1 [ICON_Tourism] 旅游业绩。

en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes receive -25% Yield and [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism, but Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes provide +0.5 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture increasing to +1 with Humanism, +0.5 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science increasing to +1 with Education, and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every Specialty District at the Destination. Cities within 6 tiles of Japan's capital receive 100% Loyalty and after researching Flight receive +1 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism for every District.

zh.name: 波斯之剑
zh.description: 攻击区域和生命值全满的单位时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]国内贸易路线+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值，解锁“教育”和“科学理论”后均额外+2 [ICON_Science] 科技值。

en.description: +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when attacking Defensible Districts and full health Units.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Receive +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for domestic Trade Routes, and an additional +2 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science with Education and Scientific Theory.

zh.name: 大帝
zh.description: 处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代时，+10% [Icon_Science] 科技值和 [Icon_Culture] 文化值。未处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代和其他文明作战时+2 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，和同样未处于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代或 [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] 英雄时代的文明作战将提升至+4 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。

en.description: +10% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture when in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age.[NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength when not in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age, doubled against Civilizations who are also not in a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age or [ICON_GLORY_SUPER_GOLDEN_AGE] Heroic Age.

zh.name: 阿克苏姆的遗产
zh.description: 埃塞俄比亚的国际贸易路线起点处每拥有一种资源，其提供的 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值便+0.5。“帝国初期”市政后，改良后的资源+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。可用信仰值购买考古博物馆和考古学家。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3草原丘陵与平原丘陵。

en.description: Ethiopia's International Trade Routes grant +0.5 [ICON_FAITH] Faith per resource at the origin. Improved Resources provide +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith. Can purchase Archaeological Museums and Archaeologists with [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Grassland and Plains Hills.

zh.name: 内阁会议
zh.description: 获得等同于建在丘陵或资源上的城市所产生 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值的10%的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.description: Receive [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 10% of your [ICON_FAITH] Faith generation in cities founded on Hills or Resources.

zh.name: 巴比伦诸神
zh.description: 建造完成图书馆后获得一项免费 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3河流。

en.description: Receive a free [ICON_TechBoosted] Eureka after constructing each Library.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T3 Rivers.

zh.name: 尼鲁-伊路-辛鲁
zh.description: 首次建造出一种 [ICON_DISTRICT] 专业化区域（市政广场除外）时，获得当前可在该区域中建造的、所需 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力最低的建筑。

en.description: When each [ICON_DISTRICT] specialty district type except the Government Plaza is constructed for the first time, receive the lowest [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost building that can currently be constructed in that district.

zh.name: 阿瑜陀耶宗主国加成
zh.description: 建筑建成时，获得等同于其 [ICON_Production] 生产力花费20%的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。

en.description: Gain [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to 20% of the [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production cost when finishing buildings.

zh.name: 欣盖提宗主国加成
zh.description: 国际与国内 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线提供的 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值 +2，神学和归正会后分别再 +2。

en.description: International and Domestic [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes receive +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith for every follower of your founded or majority [ICON_RELIGION] religion in the origin city.

zh.name: 约翰内斯堡宗主国加成
zh.description: 每拥有1种类型（加成/奢侈/战略）的改良资源，城市便+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。研究“弹道学”之后额外+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。研究“工业化”之后额外+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

en.description: Cities receive +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for each improved type of resource (bonus, luxury, strategic). Receive an additional +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production at Ballistics and at Industrialization.

zh.name: 那烂陀宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的建造者现在可以建造大寺改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值、+1 [Icon_Housing] 住房。每与1座圣地区域相邻，则+1 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值；每与1座学院区域相邻，则+1 [ICON_Science] 科技值。研究完“科学理论”之后，每与1座学院相邻则额外+1 [Icon_Science] 科技值。玩家首次建成大寺时将随机获得一项科技。必须建在平坦地貌上，不能与其他大寺相邻。

zh.name: 撒马尔罕宗主国加成
zh.description: 您的建造者现在能够建造圆顶市集改良设施。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。每与一个奢侈品资源相邻则+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。起源城市每有一座圆顶市集，对外国际贸易 [ICON_TradeRoute] 路线额外+2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币、+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。无法建在另一座圆顶市集旁。

en.description: Your Builders can now make Trading Dome improvements.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]+2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold. +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each adjacent Luxury resource. Your outgoing international Trade Routes grant +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith per Trading Dome at the origin. Cannot be built next to another Trading Dome.

zh.name: 沃林宗主国加成
zh.description: 陆地单位击杀主要和小型文明的单位时，将获得 [ICON_GreatGeneral] 大将军点数，而海军单位完成击杀将获得 [ICON_GreatAdmiral] 海军统帅点数，获得量等同于对方单位战斗力的25%（标准速度下）。

zh.name: 童话国王
zh.description: 奇观（即使未建成）从每个相邻区域处获得+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值，这个 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值显示在城市产出中。解锁“城堡”之后，所有文化 [ICON_CULTURE] 相邻加成将提供 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。

en.description: Wonders (complete and incomplete) receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every adjacent [ICON_DISTRICT] District as adjacency bonus. All [ICON_CULTURE] Culture adjacencies provide [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism with Castles.

zh.name: 悔改
zh.description: 获得“政治哲学”市政后，圣地每相邻一个区域+1 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。农场可以为跑马场和圣地提供+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值相邻加成。

en.description: After researching Political Philosophy, Holy Sites provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent district. Farms provide a +1 [ICON_FAITH] Faith adjacency to Hippodromes and Holy Sites.

zh.name: 谚文
zh.description: 解锁新时代的首项科技时，获得相当于每回合 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值收益 150% 的 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]书院每与一个非剧院广场区域相邻，则-1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。剧院广场为书院提供+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值，书院为剧院广场提供+2 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。拥有书院和剧院广场的城市从每个区域获得+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值、+2 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]“封建主义”市政后，没有总督的城市生产建造者时+30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。

en.description: When you complete your first Technology from a new Era, receive double your [ICON_SCIENCE] Science per turn as [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. Seowons receive -1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for each adjacent District. Seowons and Theater Squares receive major adjacency from each other. Cities with a Seowon and a Theater Square receive +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +2 [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism per district. +30% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production toward builders in cities without [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governors after Feudalism.

zh.name: 凛冬之韧
zh.description: 所有单位受伤带来的战斗力减益 -50%。

en.name: Our Homes, Our Faith, and Our Country
en.description: All Military Units in friendly territory receive a bonus to [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength based on tile appeal, +3 in Average, +4 in Charming, and +5 in Breathtaking.

en.name: Sissi
en.description: A unique land unit

zh.name: 卡勒瓦拉
zh.description: 冻土和冻土丘陵的非市中心单元格上：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]树林或资源提供 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物（不可叠加）；[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]拥有“法典”市政后，魅力值为“惊艳”的资源提供 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]拥有“政治哲学”市政后即可在古树林 2 个单元格范围内栽种树林。建成 3 个古树林后，在 [ICON_CAPITAL] 首都获得 1 个自然学家。购买自然学家的 [ICON_FAITH] 花费 -50%。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1冻土、T4树林。

en.name: Kalevala
en.description: Cities on the [ICON_Capital] Capital's continent receive +1 Loyalty per turn. Cities at maximum Loyalty receive an additional +10% [ICON_Culture] Culture and +10% [ICON_Production] Production. Unimproved Woods and Lake tiles yield +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +1 [ICON_Production] Production.

en.name: Sauna
en.description: A unique improvement

zh.name: 印度之家
zh.description: 国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线必须起源于海岸城市，并只能在水域或运河单元格上通行，但“制图学”科技后+50% [ICON_GOLD] 金币产出、“教育”科技后+50% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值产出、“中世纪集市”市政后+50% [ICON_Culture] 文化值产出。商人单位在水域中的行动范围+50%，且解锁之后可立即在水域中行动。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T1海岸。

en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Routes must originate from a coastal city and can only travel over water or canal tiles, but receive +50% [ICON_GOLD] Gold with Cartography, +50% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science with Education, and +50% [ICON_CULTURE] Culture with Medieval Faires. Trader units have +50% range over water, and can embark as soon as they are unlocked.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]Bias: T1 Coast.

zh.name: 关闸
zh.description: 所有单位+1视野。进入新时代时（包括游戏开始）+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。与所有的城邦开放边界。

en.description: All units receive +1 Sight. +1 [ICON_TRADEROUTE] Trade Route capacity when entering a new era (ancient era included). Open Borders with all City-States.

zh.name: 正义主义
zh.description: 喜欢拥有快乐市民和高 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力的文明。厌恶市民不满、生产力低下或政体不同的文明。

en.name: Justicialismo
en.description: Likes civilizations with Happy Citizens that generate high [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Dislikes civilizations with Unhappy Citizens, low Production or players with Different Governments.

zh.name: 阿尔拉巴尔
zh.description: 阿根廷特色社区，解锁于“政治哲学”市政。根据单元格吸引力获得最多 +6 [ICON_HOUSING] 住房。从相邻区域获得标准 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力相邻加成。每座城市仅限建造一个。

en.name: Arrabal
en.description: Argentine unique replacement for the Neighborhood district. Aside from the base housing based on appeal, Arrabales also generate +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production for every 2 adjacent districts. When adjacent to a district it also generates +1 [ICON_GREATPERSON] Great Musician Point.

zh.name: 文明与野蛮
zh.description: 尽可能扩张领土。厌恶有相邻单位或领土的文明，以及科技比其落后的文明。

en.name: Civilización y Barbarie
en.description: Will try to expand as much as possible. Dislikes civilizations with adjacent units or territory, and civilizations with less technologies than him.

zh.name: 庄园
zh.description: 罗卡领导的阿根廷特色区域，替代军营，通过"骑马"解锁。庄园允许无需军械库即可训练军事工程师，且速度提升25%，边境扩张速率+25%。与牧场和堡垒相邻时获得 [ICON_FOOD] 食物相邻加成。

en.name: Estancia
en.description: Replacement for the Encampment district for Roca's Argentina, unlocked with Horseback Riding. Estancias allow Military Engineers to be trained without Armories and 25% Faster, and increase the Border Expansion rate by 25%. They also have a [ICON_FOOD] Food Adjacency Bonus with Pastures and Forts.

zh.name: 征服沙漠
zh.description: 在文明边境旁作战时获得 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力加成。在己方堡垒或牧场旁击败敌方单位时，获得所有相邻单元格。完成"骑马"科技后可建造庄园区域。

en.name: Conquista del Desierto
en.description: Receive a [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Bonus when fighting adjacent to your civilization borders. When an enemy unit is defeated next to an owned Fort or a Pasture it grants you all adjacent tiles. May build Estancia Districts at the discovery of Horseback Riding.

zh.name: 劳塔罗会
zh.description: 喜欢专注于训练骑兵单位的领袖。厌恶从其他玩家手中占领过多城市的领袖。

en.name: Logia de Lautaro
en.description: Likes leaders that focus on training mounted units. Dislikes leaders who have captured too many cities from other players.

zh.name: 安第斯远征
zh.description: 击败敌方单位时获得 3 点 [ICON_GreatPerson] 大将军和 3 点 [ICON_GREATMUSICIAN] 大音乐家伟人点数（联机速度下）。[NEWLINE]近战、远程单位和摇滚乐队 +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力， [ICON_PROMOTION] 晋升时不会结束回合。

en.name: Cruce de los Andes
en.description: Mounted units may move through mountains, and generate [ICON_GreatPerson] Great Person Points for Great Generals and Great Musicians when defeating enemy units. May build Granaderos at the discovery of the Nationalism Civic.

zh.name: 掷弹骑兵
zh.description: 何塞·德·圣马丁的特色骑兵单位，替代骑兵，通过"民族主义"解锁。除普通近战攻击外还拥有较弱的远程攻击，受伤时不承受战斗力减益。

en.name: Granadero
en.description: Unique replacement for the Cavalry Unit for José de San Martín, unlocked at Nationalism. Receives a weaker Ranged Attack aside from its normal melee attack and suffers no combat penalties when damaged.

zh.name: 无衫移民
zh.description: 建造剧院广场和工业区时获得1 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口。这两个区域还额外提供+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物和 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩。

en.name: Inmigrantes Descamisados
en.description: Building Theater Squares and Industrial Districts grants 1 [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen. Both districts also generate +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food and [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism.

zh.name: 潘帕斯、马兰博与探戈
zh.description: 获得 [ICON_ENVOY] 城邦“布宜诺斯艾利斯”的宗主国效果：加成资源如同奢侈品资源一样，每种类型资源提供 1 点 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。[NEWLINE]“帝国初期”市政后，牧场提供 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物；并为圣地、学院、工业区和剧院广场提供大量相邻加成。宫殿提供 2 个 [ICON_GreatWork_MUSIC] 音乐巨作槽位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T3牧场资源。

en.name: Malambo y Tango
en.description: [ICON_GREATWORK_MUSIC]Great Works of Music generate +4 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Your Monuments receive two slots for [ICON_GREATWORK_MUSIC] Great Works of Music. Districts adjacent to Pastures generate +2 [ICON_GREATPERSON] Great Musician Points.

zh.name: 爱国军
zh.description: 阿根廷特色现代近战单位，替代步兵，解锁于“动员”市政。无法从大将军处获得 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力加成。能忽视控制区。

en.name: Gaucho
en.description: Argentine unique replacement for the Ranger unlocked at Civil Engineering, the Gaucho is a Light Cavalry Unit with the Recon promotion tree. They also receive additional healing when standing on Pasture and Farm Improvements.

zh.name: 众卡比洛斯之秘仪
zh.description: “政治哲学”市政后，军营提供的 [ICON_GreatProphet] 大预言家点数 +1。皇家学堂+1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] 影响力点数。可以使用 [Icon_Faith] 信仰值购买军营内建筑。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]创立  [ICON_Religion] 宗教后，信仰马其顿的宗教且拥有皇家学堂的己方城市，每个 [ICON_Citizen] 人口提供 +0.5 [Icon_Science] 科技值。

en.name: Cabeiri Mysteries
en.description: Receives an [ICON_ENVOY] envoy from founding a Pantheon. Assigning [ICON_ENVOY] envoys to city states grants [ICON_GreatGeneral] great general and [ICON_GreatProphet] prophet points, doubling if militaristic or religious. [NEWLINE]Cities with a Basilikoi and following Olympia's [ICON_RELIGION] religion give 1 [ICON_SCIENCE] science per [ICON_CITIZEN] population and get 1 [ICON_ENVOY] envoy. +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength in attack per suzed city state for melee and heavy cavalry units.

zh.name: 极海鲸狩
zh.description: 猎人小屋可为相邻的单元格提供额外产出：[NEWLINE]冻土单元格+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物（雪地则翻倍）；[NEWLINE]营地和渔船+1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物、+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]玩家通过科技或文化每进入一个新时代，在 [ICON_Capital] 首都获得一个“鲸鱼猎人”。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T2海岸、T1冻土。特殊：更深的冻土。

en.name: Hunting of the Bowhead
en.description: Hunter's House provide additional yields to adjacent tiles.[NEWLINE][ICON_FOOD] Food +1 for Tundra tiles (doubled for snow), [ICON_FOOD] Food +1 and [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production +1 for Camps and Fishing Boats.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Builders can consume one [ICON_CHARGES] Charge and one [ICON_CITIZEN] Citizen to create a [ICON_RESOURCE_WHALES] Whales tile.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bias: T2 Coast / T1 Tundra.

zh.name: 鲸鱼猎人
zh.description: 图勒特色陆地支援单位。拥有 1 [ICON_CHARGES] 次劳动力，可以消耗1点 [ICON_CHARGES] 劳动力和1 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口在海岸单元格上创造奢侈品资源 [ICON_RESOURCE_WHALES] “鲸鱼”。 [NEWLINE]无法训练或购买，只能通过技能获得。可以在城市间传送，解锁“占星术”科技后可以下海。

zh.name: 永思漫游
zh.description: 喜欢派遣探险者的文明。厌恶不探索的文明。

en.name: Always Long to be Roaming
en.description: Likes civilizations who send out explorers. Dislikes civilizations that do not explore.

zh.name: 心非磐石
zh.description: 侦察单位在冻土或雪地开始回合时+1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] 移动力和+5 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。

en.name: Heart not stone
en.description: [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength +5 and [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement +1 for Recon units starting their turn on Tundra or Snow tiles.

zh.name: 西境领主
zh.description: 建造完波奇特卡聚集地和大使馆建筑分别获得+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线容量。解锁特色 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督：“西雅赫·卡克”。

en.name: Lord of the West
en.description: [ICON_TRADEROUTE]Trade route capacity +1 for the Pochtecatl Enclave and the Chancellery. Unlocks the unique [ICON_GOVERNOR]Governor Fire is Born.

en.name: Hegemony of Sacred Fire
en.description: Will vigourously attack and compete for city-states. Respects warmongers and those with large armies, but dislikes those who conquer, protect, or subjugate city-states.

zh.name: 众神诞生之地
zh.description: [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线会根据所宗主城邦类型获得额外产出：[NEWLINE]宗主宗教城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]宗主军事或工业城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]宗主贸易城邦则获得 +3 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]宗主科技城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE]宗主文化城邦则获得 +1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]若宗主两个同样类型城邦，则额外产出增至三倍。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：无。

en.name: Where Men Become Gods
en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] trade routes receive additional yields based on the type of your vassalized City-States.[NEWLINE]+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for Religious, +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] for Millitaristic and Industrial, +3 [ICON_GOLD] golds for Commercial, +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for Scientific, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for Cultural. [NEWLINE]Tripled if you are the suzerain of 2 City-States of the same type.

zh.name: 金星之怒
zh.description: 当进入古典时代后，首都6环内的军事单位-2 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。首都6环外的军事单位+4 [ICON_STRENGTH] 战斗力。每启动一个 [ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡时刻，为所有单位回复5点生命值并获得2点经验值。

en.name: Wrath of Venus
en.description: Receive -2 [ICON_STRENGTH] combat strength for all units within six tiles of its [ICON_CAPITAL] capital. Units outside of this circle receive +4 [ICON_STRENGTH] combat strength. Units heal 5hp and gain 2 experience points upon completing an [ICON_TechBoosted] eureka.

zh.name: 商贸王子
zh.description: 国际 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线从起源于腓尼基城市里的每一个奢侈品资源获得+0.5 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力和2 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。在解锁“写作”科技之后可建造特色建筑“皇家陵墓”。

en.name: Merchant Princes
en.description: International [ICON_TRADEROUTE] trade routes provides +0.5 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production  and +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each Luxury resource in the originating Phoenician city. Unlock the Royal Tomb unique building.

en.name: Here and Be Humbled
en.description: Dislikes Warmongers, but likes those who send trade routes to him.

zh.name: 日内瓦公约
zh.description: 获得城邦“日内瓦”的宗主国效果：[ICON_TechBoosted] 尤里卡提供 +5% [ICON_Science] 科技开销。[NEWLINE]训练间谍时 +50% [ICON_Production] 生产力。敌方间谍在我方城市中，效力降低 1 级。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET]出生地关联：T4草原山脉、T4平原山脉。

en.name: Chronicon Helveticum
en.description: Receive +1 [ICON_FAVOR] Diplomatic Favor from allied City-States and a free [ICON_ENVOY] Envoy upon promoting a [ICON_GOVERNOR] Governor. Triggering an [ICON_CIVICBOOSTED] Inspiration grants +1 Era Score.

zh.name: 高卢邦联
zh.description: 解锁“铸铜术”科技后，矿山+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。每个工作坊+1 [ICON_InfluencePerTurn] 影响力，招募 [ICON_GreatEngineer] 大工程师时获得1 [ICON_ENVOY] 使者。

en.name: Gallic Confederation
en.description: [ICON_CULTURE] Culture +1 for mines with Bronze Working.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_INFLUENCEPERTURN] Influence per turn +1 per Workshop and Recruiting a [ICON_GREATENGINEER] Great Engineer grants 1 [ICON_ENVOY] envoy.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength +1 per type of vassalized City-State.

zh.name: 勇士之王
zh.description: 喜欢拥有强大军事力量的文明，但前提是他们没有被征服的城市。

en.name: King Over Warriors
en.description: Likes civilizations with strong armies, but only if they don’t own any captured cities.

zh.name: 文化斗争
zh.description: 解锁科技铸铜术后，立即解锁商业中心。军营区域从商业中心获得标准 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值相邻加成，从商业同业公会获得大量 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力相邻加成。

en.name: Kulturkampf
en.description: [ICON_DISTRICT_ENCAMPMENT] Encampment district buildings provide [ICON_Culture] Culture equivalent to their [ICON_Production] Production output. +10% [ICON_Culture] culture for cities with garrison units. Build the Ruhr Valley +50% faster.

zh.name: 瑞士元首
zh.description: 尽量避免战争，喜欢工业发达、经济繁荣的文明。厌恶生产力低下的文明。

en.name: Princeps Suisse
en.description: Tries to avoid wars and likes industrious Civilizations with a strong economy. Dislikes those with little production output.

zh.name: 十字路口的先驱
zh.description: 商业中心和工业区从山脉获得标准相邻加成。[NEWLINE]位于山脉 2 个单元格范围内的城市：修建市场、银行、工作坊和工厂时 +100% [ICON_Production] 生产力；“帝国初期”市政后，+1 [ICON_AMENITIES] 宜居度。

en.name: Pioneer on the Gotthard
en.description: Industrial Zones receive a standard adjacency bonus from mountains, and buildings within them provide an additional regional yield of +2 [ICON_Production] Production and +4 [ICON_Gold] Gold to Cities within 6 tiles.

zh.name: 世界屋脊
zh.description: 公民可在山脉单元格上工作。山脉单元格根据其2环内每有一个的专业化区域获得额外产出：[NEWLINE]每个市中心获得+2 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]每个工业区获得+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。[NEWLINE]每个港口或商业中心获得+1 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。[NEWLINE]每个学院获得+1 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值。[NEWLINE]每个剧院获得+1 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。[NEWLINE]每个圣地获得+1 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值。[NEWLINE]除市政广场外，相邻山脉的专业化区域可用信仰购买建筑。 [ICON_GOVERNOR] 总督每次升级（包括首次升级）都将提供5%城市 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰值产出。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]出生地关联：T3草原山脉和平原山脉。特殊：允许周边存在大量山脉。

en.name: Roof of the World
en.description: Citizens may work mountain tiles. Mountain tiles gain additional yields for each district within 2 tiles:[NEWLINE][ICON_FOOD] Food +2 per City Center, [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production +1 per Industrial Zone, [ICON_GOLD] Gold +1 per Harbor and Commercial Hub, [ICON_SCIENCE] Science +1 per Campus, [ICON_CULTURE] Culture +1 per Theater Square, [ICON_FAITH] Faith +1 per Holy Site.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Can purchase buildings in specialty districts adjacent to a mountain tile with [ICON_FAITH] Faith.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][ICON_FAITH] Faith +5% in cities with a [ICON_GOVERNOR] governor for each promotion it has.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Bias: T3 Mountains (plain, grassland, and tundra).

zh.name: 长安之克
zh.description: 拥有祭祀建筑和军营的城市训练的陆地军事单位初始便拥有一次 [ICON_PROMOTION] 升级。

en.name: Capture of Chang'an
en.description: Founding a [ICON_RELIGION] religion grants a [ICON_GOVERNOR] governor title.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Land military units trained in a city with an Encampment and a Temple start with a [ICON_PROMOTION] promotion.

zh.name: 吐蕃天神圣裔，佛陀教法弘扬。
zh.description: 致力于 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代和高 [ICON_FAITH] 信仰，并尊重那些追求 [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] 黄金时代的文明。厌恶处于黑暗时代或[ICON_FAITH] 信仰低下的文明。

en.name: Great Enlightened, Miraculous, Divine Lord
en.description: Aims to achieve Golden Ages and high levels of [ICON_Faith] Faith, and respects those who do the same. Dislikes civilizations in a Dark Age, or who are low in [ICON_Faith] Faith

zh.name: 南洋聚市
